name: appmixer.requesty
label: Requesty
description: Requesty is a GDPR-compliant, EU-hosted AI gateway and LLM router (an alternative to OpenRouter). It exposes a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint in front of 400+ models from providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, Meta and Mistral, with EU data residency, latency-based routing, auto-caching and per-key spend governance.
